D: A princess sets out across a frozen kingdom to find her sister, whose powers have locked it in winter.
P: Serve the chocolate when Anna arrives at the coronation party.
S: Anna's very excited about the chocolate
Dark chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, and white chocolate ones rolled in icing sugar like snow, piled on a silver plate.
the carrot he shares with Sven, and Olaf's nose
Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey, thyme and butter until caramelised, with a whipped feta dip.
the coronation night Anna meets Hans

Nordic open sandwiches on dark rye: smoked salmon with dill cream and egg, and leg ham with mustard butter and crunchy pickled cucumber. Boil 3 eggs for 9 minutes, cool and slice. Mix 100g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest. Mash 40g soft butter with 2 tsp wholegrain mustard. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and salt for 10 minutes. Spread 4 slices of dark rye with dill cream and top with 150g smoked salmon and egg. Spread 4 more with mustard butter and top with 150g leg ham and the drained cucumber. Halve and serve.
M: a Nordic dinner in the castle
Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, grated onion and allspice, browned in butter, simmered in a cream gravy, with mash and lingonberry jam.
Ice harvesters' creamy Nordic fish soup
the men cutting ice on the frozen lake

Chunks of salmon and white fish poached in a creamy fish broth with leek, carrot and potato, finished with dill and served with buttered rye. Soften 1 sliced leek, 2 diced carrots and 1 diced celery stick in 30g butter for 5 minutes. Add 500g diced potato and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 250ml cream and bring back to a gentle simmer. Add 400g diced white fish such as ling and 300g diced salmon and poach for 4 minutes without stirring hard. Season, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with buttered rye.
W: a nod to the Norway pavilion bakery at the parks
Soft cardamom buns, the centres filled with vanilla custard, tops spread with icing and dipped in desiccated coconut.
K: the trading post and sauna on the mountain

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with cardamom, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream, marshmallows and grated chocolate. Warm 1 litre full cream milk with 4 lightly crushed cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick until steaming, then turn off and steep 10 minutes. Strain, return to the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, a few marshmallows and grated chocolate.

s.note: Anna's very excited about the chocolate
s.how: Make two ganaches: 150g dark chocolate with 75ml hot cream, and 200g white chocolate with 60ml hot cream. Chill 3 hours. Roll the dark ones in cocoa and the white ones in icing sugar like snow. Pile on a silver plate.

s.note: the carrot he shares with Sven, and Olaf's nose
s.how: Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, thyme and 30g melted butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip. Share one with the reindeer.

m.note: a Nordic dinner in the castle
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 50g soaked breadcrumbs, a grated onion and half a tsp allspice. Roll and brown in butter, then simmer in 200ml stock and 150ml cream. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and lingonberry jam.

w.note: a nod to the Norway pavilion bakery at the parks
w.how: Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 60g sugar, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 60g butter and prove an hour. Shape 12 buns, press a hollow and fill with thick custard. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Spread icing on top and dip in coconut.
